title: Space A Hub — C4: Admin Control Plane (REST)
description: Deterministic administrative REST API for Space A: create spaces, register agents (issue agent_id + token + membership). This is a CONTROL PLANE, not an agent — every operation is deterministic CRUD with no LLM judgment. Canonical knowledge writing is C1 (MCP); for the MVP the hub also exposes the C1 lifecycle over REST (see mvpKnowledgeRestBinding).

permissionModel.rule: Membership (spaces[]) is derived from the bearer token, NEVER from a request parameter. An agent may only act within Spaces it belongs to.

errors.401: unauthorized — missing or invalid bearer token
errors.403: forbidden — authenticated but outside your Space membership

endpoints.summary: Onboard an agent: issue an agent_id and token, and join a Space.

body.token: string — use as Bearer for issue calls

mvpKnowledgeRestBinding.note: Canonical form is C1 (MCP tools). The hub exposes these over REST until the MCP adapter lands. Same permission model: space_id must be in the token's spaces[].
